stories.title: Utah women hitting a groove as a team, as shown in blowout win over Houston Christian
stories.summary: The basket was a hula hoop — at least that's how it looked for the Utah women basketball team Monday night in a 98-49 win over Houston Christian at home.

stories.title: Former FAA executive says system was never 'compromised' in Friday ground stop
stories.summary: A former executive for the FAA said the organization reacted appropriately, erring on the side of safety over convenience, as an apparent modem upgrade went awry Friday.

stories.title: Utah House Democrats elect new leader after big election gains
Idaho voters enshrined English in its Constitution. Now come the questions
stories.summary: By law, English has been Idaho's official language for more than 40 years. So some voters may have been surprised to see it on the midterm ballot.

stories.title: Trump appeals to state and federal courts to erase hush money conviction
stories.summary: A federal appeals court is weighing whether it can — or should — intervene in President Trump's hush money case now that a New York State appellate court has heard arguments in his quest to erase the historic conviction.

stories.title: Watchdog group seeks halt in use of license plate readers, accuses UDOT of overreach
stories.summary: A watchdog group is pressing Utah to order a halt in use of license-plate readers along state roadways, claiming that UDOT went too far in enacting rules governing their placement.

stories.title: The companies Utah consumers complain about the most
stories.summary: A review of 307 public consumer complaints found Action Heating, Cooling and Plumbing, Meta and Private Label Accelerator among the companies Utahns complained about most, involving more than $5 million in disputed funds.

stories.title: Pope Leo's return to Latin America reveals the missionary message of his papacy
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV's visit to South America will go down as one of the lasting images of his papacy.

stories.title: Jury finds 2 men guilty of murder in death of 18-year-old at Mount Olympus trailhead
stories.summary: Two of five men charged with killing an 18-year-old at the Mount Olympus trailhead were found guilty of murder with a gang enhancement on Friday. Another was previously convicted in juvenile court, and two still face charges.

stories.title: Utah women business leaders honored for building companies and opening doors
stories.summary: Minky Couture's Sandi Sumner Hendry receives the ATHENA Leadership Award. Six others are named Pathfinders at the chamber's 50th annual conference.

stories.title: SUU adjunct professor breaks world record, brings attention to mitochondrial research
stories.summary: Tyler LeBaron, an exercise physiology professor and molecular scientist, broke the world record for the fastest half marathon while carrying a 40-pound rucksack at the Snow Canyon Half Marathon.

stories.title: California sues OpenAI, seeking court-ordered changes after the Hugging Face hack
stories.summary: California's attorney general filed a lawsuit against OpenAI in an effort to force it to change its business practices over a cybersecurity incident in which its AI system hacked into another company on its own.
